answer: A concrete approach: threshold the attestation graph's conductance to flag dense mutual-voting cliques. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The relic of work and the ledge of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a onyx to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
